scope: E06 environment control, external per-dial evidence, final software acceptance; no publication or hardware
protected: Existing tests, scenarios, thresholds, dependency versions, public API, schema and persistence strength remain unchanged

environments: existing local macOS arm64 APFS worktree
one Ubuntu 24.04 x64 hosted runner per frozen revision
E06.intervention: Use a dedicated non-synced local evidence directory; serial workloads; no other agent-owned benchmark/build/soak on that host during the benchmark. Record filesystem, mount options, disk space, load, compiler, OS, processes and timing before/after. Do not stop unrelated processes.
E06.formal_program: original scripts/check.sh release including original tests/benchmark.py --trace-ab
E06.stop: If the original gate fails, retain failure and diagnose its specific evidence. No favorable reruns, RAM disk, WAL change, weaker sync, batching, workload reduction or environment shopping. A diagnostic pass is not formal acceptance.

dial.candidate: Unmodified native executable from the frozen source; external socket interposer and test gateway only
dial.identity: Process PID and executable hash; resolver allocation/free lifetime identifies one serial Client::dial, monotonically unique connect lifetimes identify its Happy Eyeballs TCP attempts. Match gateway accept by exact tuple, never timestamp proximity. Concurrent resolver objects, missing records and ambiguous tuple reuse fail closed.
dial.gateway: Bounded in-memory TLS and first MQTT packet records; actual numeric TLS alerts and CONNACK bytes; forwards to isolated Mosquitto for long runs. Test-only TLS termination changes the observed environment and is not direct-broker TLS acceptance.
dial.stop: Calibration failure prevents long runs. Lost records or ambiguous attribution fail evidence. Original soak outcome/resource/recovery assertions must remain active.
dial.verification_failure_case: The independent calibration driver presents client-unrelated.pem to a server requiring client-ca.pem; retain actual server alert 48 and verify_code 20. Client-side rejection need not flush an alert onto the wire and is not inferred from its error text.
